title: Sagrada Família · Plaça de Gaudí
description: The basilica's block from OpenStreetMap and 2026 photos: up the L5 stair on the Provença corner, the Nativity facade over the pedestrian Carrer de la Marina with its queue and its photographers, the portal's guard, the pond of Plaça de Gaudí under the stone pines, the Passion side on Carrer de Sardenya, the Glory's works on Mallorca, the Falqués lamps on Avinguda de Gaudí, then the overview with the spires.

steps.caption: Up the L5 stair on the Provença corner: the apse on one side, Avinguda de Gaudí behind
The camera turned to the Nativity: Gaudí's dark old stone, the three portals on their steps, the cypress, the queue at entrance A and the visitors taking the picture
Higher: the Nativity's slotted bell towers with their mosaic mitres against the pale lattice of the Evangelists' towers and the Tower of Jesus
At the foot of the Nativity: the three portals, the dripping stone, the queue along its barrier
At the foot of the Nativity portal's steps: «Entrar en la basílica» leads inside (the scenario sagrada-familia-interior walks in)
Plaça de Gaudí: the pond under the stone pines, the facade's reflection
Behind: the Passion facade on Carrer de Sardenya, seen through the cut
Gaudí's Escoles on the Sardenya corner: brick walls that wave in plan under a roof whose eaves rise and fall
The Glory on Carrer de Mallorca: still a construction front, hoarding and cranes
Avinguda de Gaudí: a Falqués lamp and the terraces, the avenue pointing at the basilica
The overview (R): the spires over the Eixample, the pond in front
Close: the Nativity's dark bell towers and mosaic mitres, the pale lattice towers, the white cross and Mary's star, the cranes over the Glory
Close: the pond in jade water under the pines, the facade upside down on it
